# StreamDek Mobile — 18 August 2026

## Fixed

**Plugin sources that read web pages return results again**
Sources that parse a page rather than call an API — ShowBox among them — found nothing, every
time, with no error to explain it. The page was being read correctly and then thrown away: the app
handed each element to the plugin under a reference the plugin could not hand back, so the first
selector matched and everything nested inside it quietly matched nothing. Every such source was
affected; sources that use plain pattern matching never were, which is why only some of a
collection looked broken.

**Plugin collections keep up with the web portal**
A collection added, switched off or reordered in the portal only appeared after the app was closed
and reopened. Add-ons refresh on almost every action, but plugins were only re-read when switching
profile. They are now re-read on sign-in and whenever the app is brought back to the front, so a
change made in a browser is there when you switch back.

**The Plugins page updates while you are looking at it**
Even once a change had arrived, the page went on showing what it held when it opened. It now
follows the collection list as it changes.

**Source tokens survive signing in on another device**
A source that needs a token or an API key — the FebBox cookie, for instance — kept it on the
device that entered it. Signing in elsewhere restored the collection with every source switched on
and no token, which looks exactly like a source that is simply broken. Those values now travel
with the profile.

**Source settings show what you typed**
A token pasted into a source's settings was hidden behind dots, which is the one thing you need to
see to check it went in correctly. It is now shown, with a control to hide it.

**Testing a source reads as a list again**
Some sources put their whole formatted card into every field, so "Test source" printed four lines
of it beneath a two-line title. It now shows the quality and size, as it was meant to.

**Resetting a password no longer waits on an email**
The reset asked for a code sent to the registered address, which never arrived. It now takes an
email and a new password, and signs you in once it is done. The button also stops accepting an
empty form. *Requires the matching backend release.*

## New

**Plugin sources can use much more of what they were written against**
Sources are written for a browser, and anything they reached for that was missing surfaced as a
source that returned nothing rather than as an error. This release supplies the rest of it:
complete hashing, signing and encryption, proper URL handling, text encoding and base64, and
cancellation. Requests are also no longer garbled when a source asks for compressed responses, a
source can now read a redirect instead of following it, and slower sources are given a full minute
before being cut off rather than twenty-five seconds.

**Sources say what went wrong**
A source that failed left nothing behind to explain it. Requests and page reads are now traced, so
a source that comes back empty can be told apart from one that was blocked, timed out, or found
nothing to match.
